implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/settings/UsersTab.tsx: Users tab in settings. Uses useUsers(). Table: username, role (Badge), created at, last login. Create user button opens form (React Hook Form + Zod): username (required, min 3 chars), password (required, min 8 chars), role dropdown (Admin, Operator, Viewer, Approver). Edit role: inline dropdown change or edit button. Change password: button opens password form modal (new password + confirm, Zod validation for match). Delete user with ConfirmDialog (disabled for own account). All user management requires admin role — show 'Insufficient permissions' if not admin.
